primitive: Attributed obligatory cell; estimates and decisions are readings, never authority

status.scientific: Conditional finite acceptance; admission is determined by standing and receipts

statement: A posterior estimate does not choose an action without a declared loss and tie rule. Information, decision information and accuracy have different units and meanings. Copy thresholds retain their declared model and decoder.
conditions: finite named states/actions and normalized exact prior
declared loss unit and all-minimizers policy for finite risk
declared plurality or posterior MAP and uniform ties in the single-dominant-factor model
population and model hypotheses are inputs, not inferred lineage independence

numericReporting.boundary: Decimal equality is not exact equality of real information. Original Node-version transcripts are retained.
